intro: Reference: click a button or knob to learn what it does. MORPH makes a sound; REC catches it in one of three rings; the rings are scanned. Hold GLO on the FM-1 for the same guide on its screen. Use Play to perform, or Guide for a short walkthrough.
master: Output volume. MASTER is always the volume.
screen: The three rings are the circles, RING 1 innermost, each drawn as its recording's wave; the selected one is bright, a ring that is playing amber. The white notch outside a ring is its head; the dots on it are grains. MORPH is the square in the middle: large on its own page, with the path a note's hidden envelopes take and, underneath, a note's loudness over one ring. The foot names what each knob sets.
keys: With no ring yet, a key strikes MORPH and the note is caught in ring 1. After that, on SCAN and MIX, the keys play the selected ring while held. SLICE (as it starts): the 16 white keys are 16 places round the ring and the black keys the places between, as on a pocket sampler. PITCH (SEL switches): the ring transposed, the C as recorded.
select: Chooses the ring, on every page: the one SCAN's knobs set, the keys play and REC records into.

KNOB1: Where in the ring the grains start, round and round. Turn it to scrub through the recording.
KNOB2: Each grain's length, 20 ms to 1 s.
KNOB3: How many grains overlap. Low: a grain now and then. About x2: the plain recording. Higher: a thick cloud.
KNOB4: The ring transposed, two octaves down to two up, in semitones.
ALGORITHM: The head going round: backward on the left, still in the middle (a frozen moment), as recorded at 1.0x, twice as fast at the right.
PRESETS: Grains scattered round the head, and in time.

morph.title: MORPH
keys: A key strikes a note that lasts exactly one ring (1.49 s). It plays MORPH as it is set now; behind it, hidden envelopes carry X and Y toward their mirror image and back, and make it brighter early and darker late (MOVE says how far). Up to four at once.

KNOB1: Across the square: FM and ADD on the left, MODAL and FOLD on the right.
KNOB2: Up the square: ADD and FOLD at the bottom, FM and MODAL at the top.
KNOB3: How rich each way of making sound is.
ALGORITHM: How far a note's hidden envelopes move it: X and Y to their mirror image and back over the note, the brightness falling. 0: it stays where the knobs are.
PRESETS: A note's loudness over its ring: a pluck, a bell, a swell. It is always silent again by the ring's end, so a recording loops clean.

KNOB4: MORPH's own level, heard as you play it.
PRESETS: The three rings spread across the stereo field.

EDIT.label: SCAN
EDIT.text: Opens SCAN: the selected ring's POSITION, SIZE, DENSITY, PITCH, SPEED and SPREAD. Each ring keeps its own.

HOME.label: SCAN
HOME.text: Back to SCAN. It clears nothing.

FX.label: MORPH
FX.text: Opens MORPH. Here the keys strike its notes, each one ring long.

ARP.label: MIX
ARP.text: Opens MIX: each ring's level, MORPH's, DAMP and WIDTH.

SEL.label: KEYS
SEL.text: Switches what the keys do on SCAN and MIX: SLICE (places round the ring) or PITCH (the ring transposed). Lit: PITCH.

PLAY.label: PLAY
PLAY.text: The rings going round, on and off. A key held on SCAN or MIX sounds its ring either way.

REC.label: REC
REC.text: On MORPH: armed (blinking), and the next note is caught in the selected ring from its first sample: one note, one ring, a clean loop. On SCAN or MIX: everything heard except the selected ring is resampled into it now, so the rings can be made from each other.

GLO.label: GUIDE
GLO.text: Hold GLO for the button guide on the screen; let go to return.

SAVE.text: Nothing: PALINDROME does not save its rings.

guide.label: Guide
guide.done: That is PALINDROME: MORPH notes caught one ring long, three rings scanned and sliced, and each ring able to be made from the others.

steps.title: Switch on
steps.text: Press Switch on, on the panel. The three circles are empty rings.

steps.title: Touch
steps.text: Tap any key. MORPH strikes a note one ring long; it is caught in ring 1 and starts going round.

steps.title: Scan
steps.text: Turn KNOB1 POSITION to scrub through the ring, and ALGORITHM SPEED to the middle to freeze it. Then hold a few keys: each is a place in the ring.

steps.title: Another ring
steps.text: Turn SELECT to ring 2 and press FX for MORPH. Press REC, then tap a key: that note is caught in ring 2.

steps.title: From each other
steps.text: Press EDIT, turn SELECT to ring 3 and press REC: rings 1 and 2, as you hear them, are resampled into ring 3.
